title_en: Mattel Has Regained the DC License, and We Can Exclusively Reveal Their First New Batman Figure
summary_en: With Mattel regaining the rights to DC's vast lineup of characters, we can reveal the very first DC Premium figure ahead of its debut at NYCC. And yes, it's Batman.
body_en:
The collectibles world is undergoing a seismic shift right now. The license for DC figures is shifting from McFarlane Toys to Mattel. And while Mattel has already released a number of new kid-focused figures under the "DC Core" branding, older collectors are eagerly awaiting news about the "DC Premium" line. Just ahead of its official debut at NYCC, IGN can exclusively reveal the very first DC Premium figure. And yes, it's Batman.
Head down to the slideshow gallery below for an exclusive first look at the DC Premium Batman: Hush Rooftop Bat-Signal Diorama Set:
It's hardly surprising that Mattel would choose Batman of all characters to kick off the DC Premium line. This particular figure is based on the 2002-03 storyline Batman: Hush and the artwork of Jim Lee. It features no fewer than 34 points of articulation, so you should be able to get some very dynamic superhero poses out of it.
This isn't a standard action figure release, however. It's a larger bundle that includes a rooftop diorama base and a light-up Bat-Signal accessory. The figure also includes a posable, wired fabric cape and interchangeable hands.
“We are incredibly proud to bring DC back to Mattel, marking an exciting new chapter with the debut of Batman: Hush," said Nick Karamanos, General Manager & Head of Entertainment Partnerships, Action Figures and Preschool Entertainment at Mattel, in a statement. "We know there has been tremendous anticipation for this launch, and we’re excited to deliver what fans expect from a Mattel action figure — the very best.”
The DC Premium Batman: Hush Rooftop Bat-Signal Diorama Set is priced at $100 and is available to order now on the Mattel Creations website .
This new set will be on display at DC's NYCC booth (#4365) this week. Mattel is also teasing that future DC Premium figures will be revealed during a livestream event happening on January 1, 2027.
For more collectibles fun at NYCC, check out our reveal of Hasbro's new Street Fighter movie figures and see Funko's NYCC-exclusive Green Lantern figures .
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
